mosfetDistributor.intro: Power MOSFETs are one of the most requested parts at our Lamington Road office, and one of the most counterfeited in the market. We supply genuine MOSFETs from Infineon, ON Semi, STMicroelectronics and Vishay with a Certificate of Conformance.
applications: Solar inverters, UPS and battery backup: N-channel MOSFETs in bridge and boost stages, usually TO-220 or TO-247.

Motor drives and fan controllers: efficient switching.
Battery management and chargers: low R_DS(on) parts reduce heat; P-channel parts give reverse-polarity protection.

howToPick.title: How to Pick a MOSFET
tips: Voltage (V_DS): leave real margin above the highest voltage in the circuit, including spikes.
Current (I_D): the headline rating is usually at 25°C case temperature. Derate for your real operating temperature.
R_DS(on): lower means less heat, but R_DS(on) rises as the junction heats up.
Gate drive: logic-level types turn on fully at 4.5 V or lower; standard types need about 10 V.
Package: TO-220 and TO-247 suit heatsinks; TO-252 and SO-8 rely on PCB copper; SOT-23 is for small loads.
Channel: N-channel for low-side switching; P-channel for high-side switching and reverse-polarity protection.

mosfetCalculator.h2: MOSFET Thermal and Power Loss Calculator
mosfetCalculator.workedExample: Worked Example: IRFZ44N, I_RMS 10 A, R_DS(on) 17.5 mΩ, T_A 40°C, θ_JA 62°C/W. Conduction loss P_cond = 1.75 W. Temperature rise = 108.5°C. T_J = 148.5°C, just under the limit. If R_DS(on) rises to ~30 mΩ when hot, loss becomes 3 W and T_J reaches ~226°C, which fails. That is why designers add a heatsink or pick a lower-resistance part.
mosfetCalculator.disclaimer: Disclaimer: this is a quick estimate. Real designs also include switching loss, duty cycle, PCB cooling and the rise of R_DS(on) with temperature. Check the datasheet.

howToPick.title: How to Pick a MOSFET for a Mains-Connected Design
tips: Voltage: mains-rectified supplies need real margin. A 230V supply rectifies to ~325V DC, and switching spikes sit on top, so 500V or 600V parts are common.
R_DS(on): high-voltage MOSFETs have much higher on-resistance, so they heat up even at modest current.
Gate drive: check that the driver supplies enough gate voltage and current.
Package: TO-220 and TO-247 work with heatsinks and insulating pads.
Protection: add TVS and snubber circuits, because inductive spikes are the most common cause of failure.

howToPick.title: How to Pick a MOSFET for Dairy, Mill and Pump Drives
tips: Voltage: motor loads kick back inductive spikes, so leave real margin above the DC bus. A rectified 230V supply gives ~325V DC, so 500V parts are common in mains-side stages.
Derate for heat: chiller rooms, mill floors and summer enclosures are hot, so use a real heatsink and a good thermal pad.
Gate drive: make sure the driver supplies enough gate voltage and current, and add a gate resistor.
Find the cause of failure: when replacing a failed MOSFET in a drive, check the gate driver, snubber and supply.
Surge protection: long cable runs to pumps and motors pick up spikes, so add TVS diodes.
Parallel carefully: use matched parts, equal gate resistors and a symmetrical layout.

This illustrates how a bare TO-220 runs out of headroom at higher currents and requires an adequate heatsink.

Quality control protocols at defence contractors in Balanagar and ECIL require complete batch provenance and Certificate of Conformance documentation. Mirai Technologies supplies factory-inspected ICs with verified lot codes shipped via express air freight from Mumbai.

Featured IC Lines for Defence & Aerospace PSUs:
- LM358 / OP07 (Low-noise, precision operational amplifiers)
- LM339 (Quad voltage comparator for signal conditioning)
- ULN2003 (7-channel peripheral driver IC)
- Obsolete IC sourcing for long-lifecycle legacy programs
whyMirai: Certificate of Conformance (CoC) provided. Air express 24-48h delivery to Hyderabad. Contact: sales@miraitechnologies.net.
productCategories: Precision linear ICs, logic series, and interface transceivers.
targetIndustries: Defence PSUs, Aerospace Subcontractors, Medical Electronics
industriesWeServe: Serving high-reliability electronics units in ECIL, Balanagar, and Cherlapally.
